title: Transport of representative-normalized derived tensor comparisons
statement: Fix native pro-etale f:X→Y, R,S,c and native tensor models a,b [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Let L:Mod(R)→Mod(S) be additive, e:L≅f*, d an ExactModel of L and l:d.functor≅Lf* with l(QC);nativeFactors(C)=d.factors(C);Q(e_C(C)) for every complex C. Let ay,bx be TensorModels and μ an ordinary comparison with e(M⊗N);μ_native=μ;tensor(e(M),e(N)). Let tc be a TensorComparison for L,d,ay,bx,μ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction]. Suppose ea:a.tensor≅ay.functor and eb:b.tensor≅bx.functor restrict on resolving pairs to a.representative⁻¹;ay.representative and b.representative⁻¹;bx.representative. Then for every M,N in D(R), l(a(M,N));α_native(M,N);eb(Lf*M,Lf*N)=d.functor(ea(M,N));tc.comparison(M,N);bx(l(M),l(N)). This asserts only the tensor square, with no right adjoint or projection mate.

proof.text: Use the existing pro-etale resolving descent datum with target D(S) to reduce equality of the two natural transformations to a resolving pair P,Q.

Prepend the mapped native source representative and postcompose the native pullback factors and inverse target representative. These comparisons are invertible. Use the ea,eb representative equations and naturality to move them across the factors. The two representative normalizations identify the paths with their respective inverse total comparisons, together with the factorization of l.

The total transport square identifies these inverse total comparisons after mapping to the derived category. The supplied total comparison is invertible because the other three sides of this square are invertible. Cancel the comparisons and reflect equality through resolving restriction.

theorem proEtaleTensorComparisonTransport
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (L : Mod R ⥤ Mod S) [L.Additive]
    (e : L ≅ proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c) (d : ExactModel L)
    (l : d.functor ≅ proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c)
    (hf : ∀ C : CochainComplex (Mod R) ℤ,
      l.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≫
        (proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackFactors f R S c).hom.app C =
      d.factors.hom.app C ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex e (.up ℤ)).hom.app C))
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel Y R) (b : ProEtaleTensorModel X S)
    (ay : TensorModel R) (bx : TensorModel S)
    (mu : ∀ M N : Mod R, L.obj (((tensor R).obj M).obj N) ≅
      ((tensor S).obj (L.obj M)).obj (L.obj N))
    (tc : TensorComparison L d ay bx mu)
    (he : ∀ M N : Mod R,
      e.hom.app (((tensor R).obj M).obj N) ≫
        (proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullback f R S c M N).hom =
      (mu M N).hom ≫ ((tensor S).map (e.hom.app M)).app (L.obj N) ≫
        ((tensor S).obj ((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).obj M)).map (e.hom.app N))
    (ea : a.tensor ≅ ay.functor) (eb : b.tensor ≅ bx.functor)
    (ha : Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
      (((resolving R).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod
        ((resolving R).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)) ea = a.representative.symm ≪≫ ay.representative)
    (hb : Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
      (((resolving S).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod
        ((resolving S).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)) eb = b.representative.symm ≪≫ bx.representative) :
    ∀ M N : Der R,
      l.hom.app (a.tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
          (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f R S c a b).hom.app (M, N) ≫
          eb.hom.app ((proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c).obj M,
            (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c).obj N) =
        d.functor.map (ea.hom.app (M, N)) ≫ tc.comparison.hom.app (M, N) ≫
          bx.functor.map (Prod.mkHom (l.hom.app M) (l.hom.app N))
